subject: Evaluation + renewal path: Drata vs AuditTrail (SOC2 automation + PO timing)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation + renewal path: Drata vs AuditTrail (SOC2 automation + PO timing)

Team —

Quick context: our current Drata contract renews end of June. Procurement flagged a potential pricing jump for 2028 commit, and Security has a list of evidence friction we still run into quarterly. AuditTrail (new vendor) responded to our RFP and sent an implementation approach that promises more automation for infra evidence and CI/CD hooks.

Asks:
- Security: can you confirm the non-negotiable controls we need automated vs manual for the upcoming SOC2 run? (Evelyn)
- Procurement: can we get an expected PO timeline and whether we can do a partial-year addendum if we switch mid-year? (Marissa, Ben)
- Legal: any gotchas if we pilot AuditTrail for prod infra evidence while keeping Drata for org-level controls? (Karthik)

I attached the vendor response and a quick scope-diff I drafted. Goal: decide by Apr 15 whether to: (A) renew Drata early at a fixed rate, (B) pilot AuditTrail and delay full renewal, or (C) request a one-off bridging PO with Drata while we run a 90-day AuditTrail pilot.

Thanks — please reply with availability for a 30m decision call this week.

— Mina
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marco Rinaldi <marco@audittrail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Cc: procurement@audittrail.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation + renewal path: Drata vs AuditTrail (SOC2 automation + PO timing)

Hi Mina / Marissa —

Thanks for the RFP review and the scope doc. A few quick clarifications from our side:
- Implementation cadence: we typically deliver infra evidence ingestion + CI/CD connectors in 4–6 weeks for customers in your size band, and SOC2-ready evidence workflows in 8–10 weeks.
- Pilot terms: we can run a 90-day pilot with a reduced fee ($12k for the pilot) that includes hands-on onboarding and a week of on-site enablement (remote/onsite options listed).
- Data handling: AuditTrail stores minimal copies of raw artifacts; we provide a customer-managed S3 option and HSM/KMS integrations for keys.

I attached our formal response (AuditTrail_RFP_response_20270403.pdf). If helpful, I can do a 20m demo focused strictly on your infra connectors later this week.

Best,
Marco
Head of Sales Engineering
AuditTrail
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation + renewal path: Drata vs AuditTrail (SOC2 automation + PO timing)

Group —

Procurement notes after quick review with Finance:
- Drata quoted a 12% list increase for 2028 if we sign a new 12-month renewal now; current contract allows cancellation with 30 days notice but no pro-rated refunds for mid-year termination. They provided a new quote (Drata_quote_Q2_2027.xlsx).
- Finance prefers avoiding a full 12-month commit if we can run a short pilot instead; a bridging PO (3 months) to cover Drata for Q3 while we pilot AuditTrail seems acceptable if cost delta is < $25k and legal approves risk acceptance.
- Need final pricing and a procurement contact at AuditTrail to issue an initial PO for the pilot.

Marissa — can you take the lead on getting a pilot SOW and pilot invoice? Marco — who should we bill and what is the exact pilot fee schedule?

— Ben
Senior Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Marco Rinaldi <marco@audittrail.com>, procurement@audittrail.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation + renewal path: Drata vs AuditTrail (SOC2 automation + PO timing)

Marco — thanks. Can you confirm the following in writing so we can route to Finance:
1) Pilot SOW doc or one-pager stating scope + deliverables and the $12k fee (and what is included/excluded).
2) Billing contact and invoice remit details for AuditTrail (company name for PO, remit address, tax ID).
3) Any standard T&Cs you require for a 90-day pilot; if you require full SaaS terms we will ask Legal to redline a short pilot addendum.

Evelyn — on the controls: please confirm which control families must be left on Drata if we run parallel systems (I think CC1/CC2 for org-level policies may remain on Drata).

I'll draft an initial PO once we have the SOW + remit info.

— Marissa
Sr. Procurement Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Marco Rinaldi <marco@audittrail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: procurement@audittrail.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation + renewal path: Drata vs AuditTrail (SOC2 automation + PO timing)

Marissa — attaching the requested one-pager and remit details in this thread. Short answers inline: 

1) Pilot SOW: attached one-pager (scope = infra evidence ingestion for compute + storage, CI/CD connector setup, 2 enablement sessions, weekly syncs). Deliverables: pipeline configured, evidence proof-of-playbook, admin training.
2) Billing: AuditTrail, Inc. | 123 Market St, Suite 400, SF, CA 94105 | Tax ID: 94-1234567. Invoice contact: finance@audittrail.com.
3) T&Cs: we can sign a pilot addendum limited to the 90-day scope; full SaaS contract can wait until pilot completion.

We will also share an updated PO-ready invoice by EOD tomorrow.

Looking forward to the call — available Thu 4pm PT for a 30m alignment.

— Marco
Head of Sales Engineering
AuditTrail
